subject: polity
title: Important Articles of the Constitution
description: Key articles covering Union/State Legislature, President, Governor, and emergency provisions

content.overview: The Constitution of India has 448 articles in 25 parts. Here are the most important ones for UPSC/PSC exams.
keyPoints: Article 1: Name and territory of the Union
Article 74: Council of Ministers to aid and advise President
Article 368: Power of Parliament to amend Constitution

mnemonics.explanation: Three types of emergencies: National Emergency (352), Financial Emergency (360), President's Rule (356)
Union Executive articles: President (74), VP (75), PM (76), Ministers (77)

mnemonics.trick: 52-78 President | 79-122 Union Legislature | 153-167 Governor | 168-212 State Legislature
mnemonics.explanation: President: Articles 52-78; Parliament (Union Legislature): 79-122; Governor: 153-167; State Legislature: 168-212
Art 79 (Parliament), 80 (RS composition), 81 (LS composition), 108 (joint sitting), 110 (money bill), 111 (assent), 112 (budget), 123 (President's ordinance)
Art 168 (state legislatures), 191 (disqualification of MLAs), 200 (Governor's assent), 202 (state budget), 213 (Governor's ordinance)

quiz.question: Which article deals with National Emergency?
Money Bill is defined in which article?
Which article gives the right to move Supreme Court for enforcement of Fundamental Rights?
quiz.explanation: Article 32 gives the right to move Supreme Court for enforcement of Fundamental Rights

timeline.event: Constitution came into force with 395 articles
